subject: StellaData MAP: Dedicated/Private capacity sizing & close timeline
messages:
From: Ben Lowe <ben@stellardata.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marina Cho <mcho@stellardata.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: MAP kickoff: capacity targets and timeline

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We'd like to put a MAP in place to drive to a close on Dedicated/Private capacity for our inference workloads. High-level asks from StellaData:

- Target steady-state throughput: ~200 requests/sec (gen workload; 8k context typical)
- p50 latency goal: <= 220ms; p99 SLO: <= 1.8s
- Region footprint: primary US (us-west), secondary EU (eu-west) for GDPR tenants
- Preferred SKUs: H100 for user-facing inference; A100 for batch/embeddings if cheaper
- Timeline: procurement window suggests we need committed capacity in place by 2026-11-25 to align with Q4 feature launch

Can you share a sizing proposal (GPU type/count per region), estimated cost delta between Dedicated vs Private, and a short mutual action plan with owners and target close steps? I'm looping Marina to help with procurement constraints.

I attached a short RFP excerpt.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Lowe
Head of ML Infrastructure, StellaData

Attachment: RFP_StellaData_excerpt.pdf (pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>

Appreciate the clear asks. I've sketched a short MAP and a first-pass sizing estimate and attached it (stellardata_map_draft.xlsx). Proposed next steps:

1) Internal sizing confirmation (Lauren) — confirm GPU mix + throughput headroom (owner: lauren_bishop) — by 2026-11-12
2) Procurement constraints & contract guardrails (StellaData) — Marina to confirm lead times and approval steps — by 2026-11-17
3) Final quote + deployment window (Redwood Ops) — aditya_rao to confirm availability and lead times — by 2026-11-18
4) Exec signoff and PO (StellaData) — target 2026-11-25 close

Brief overview in the draft: we recommend a hybrid Dedicated pool for US traffic with Private deployment for EU-only regulated tenants. See the draft for the matrix. Happy to jump on a 30m call tomorrow to walk through.

Best,
Connor O

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Lowe <ben@stellardata.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: capacity targets and timeline

Connor / Ben —

I ran the workload profile against our throughput model and here's a concise sizing recommendation (attached as PDF summary and I added the calc sheet to the drive link):

US (primary, us-west):
- H100 fast-inference cluster: 8x H100 (4 partitions of 2 GPUs each for redundancy)
- Baseline throughput: ~220 req/s at 8k context with continuous batching + KV prefix caching
- Burst headroom: +40% w/ autoscale (burst policy to H100 spare pool)

EU (secondary, eu-west):
- A100xLarge pool: 4x A100 (for regulated tenants and embeddings)
- Baseline throughput: ~60 req/s local; routed overflow to US Dedicated when cross-border allowed

Notes on latency: H100 cluster configuration and optimized kernel selection expected to meet p50/p99 targets. We recommend enabling prefix caching for session-heavy flows (reduces tokens by ~12-15% on average).

I've attached sizing_estimate_20261111.pdf and the calc CSV is on the drive. Action items I'll own: validate memory/kv sizing and provide a per-month cost delta between Dedicated and Private by EOD 2026-11-12.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachment: sizing_estimate_20261111.pdf (pdf)
Attachment referenced: sizing_calc_20261112.csv (csv)

Team —

Quick operational check: lead times for H100 racks in our Dedicated pool are currently 3–4 weeks for reserved capacity, but we have burst allocations that can be provisioned within 3 business days for initial ramp. For Private (VPC) installs in eu-west we need procurement windows ~2–3 weeks and on-prem validations if they want air-gapped images.

Requested items from StellaData (Marina / Ben):
- Confirm which tenants must remain EU-only (list of tenant ids)
- PoC traffic window for initial ramp (are you expecting full prod cutover or progressively routed?)

I'll prepare the exact provisioning schedule once procurement confirms PO led times. Putting tentative owner assignments into the MAP spreadsheet.

-Aditya
